description: One storage registry's authorized address round trip. Replay in order: each enrollment is the storage instruction of tag 5 the owner signs, its ring_id comes from the registry. Each step is one Update whose writes_wire is the StorageWriteData::encode_all bytes. Write kind 2 takes its hash from the enrollment at address_revision, never from instruction data. address_hash = Poseidon(CRAD, ring_id, member, nullifier_pk, view0, view1, address_revision). entry_hash = Poseidon(CRQW, member, mask, value, escrow_key, mint_policy, withdrawal_threshold, limits_0, limits_1, limits_2, address_hash). leaf_hash = Poseidon(member, next, lists, escrow_key, mint_policy, withdrawal_threshold, limits_0, limits_1, limits_2, address_hash). A write's pair is the ApplyRecords preimage witness, null when the write creates or changes no address and escrow pair. escrow_key = Poseidon(nullifier_pk, ciphertext_hash). chain_start binds the registry and batch_revision, a separate counter from address_revision. Every opening verifies under its step's new_root, in the order of owners, and an absent owner's address and escrow are those of its low record. u64 values are decimal strings, paths list three siblings per level, leaf level first. Produced by program-libs/member-registry/tests/address_record_vector.rs.
